input._script:
using JSON3
out = Dict{String,Any}()
try
    depot = first(Base.DEPOT_PATH)
    out["depots"] = Base.DEPOT_PATH
    out["julia"] = string(VERSION)
    pk = joinpath(depot, "packages", "JACC")
    out["installed_versions_dirs"] = isdir(pk) ? readdir(pk) : "none in $pk"
    import JACC
    out["loaded_jacc"] = string(pkgversion(JACC))
    d = mktempdir(get(ENV, "WORK", "/tmp"))
    code = "import Pkg; Pkg.add(name=\"JACC\", version=\"1.4.0\"); import JACC; println(\"JACCVER \", pkgversion(JACC))"
    cmd = `timeout 300 $(Base.julia_cmd()) --project=$d -e $code`
    buf = IOBuffer()
    p = run(pipeline(ignorestatus(cmd); stdout = buf, stderr = buf))
    out["install_exit"] = p.exitcode
    out["install_tail"] = last(String(take!(buf)), 1500)
catch e
    out["error"] = first(sprint(showerror, e, catch_backtrace()), 2000)
end
println(JSON3.write(out))
